notes:
Profile: mid-market SaaS vendor for contact centers. Heavy emphasis on RAG over existing support KBs (Zendesk, Confluence, Google Drive, internal SQL store).

Key requirements (customer language / paraphrase):
- "Must show sources with timestamps — agents need a \"click-to-source\" link and citation snippet"
- "Freshness: KB updates multiple times per day, need incremental ingestion and metadata-driven freshness windows"
- "Multi-source retrieval + deduplication: same article exists in Confluence and Drive; want provenance and single canonical answer with links to all sources"
- "Tool-calling: agent assist should be able to call ticket-update APIs, create follow-ups, and surface suggested macros (function/tool-calling required)"
- "Reliability under spikes: peak loads during product incidents (evening window) can be 10x baseline; need autoscaling, burst capacity, and graceful degradation (fallback to smaller model + cached answers)"
- "Latency targets: p50 <150ms, p95 <500ms for agent assist flows; throughput goal 200-1,000 req/s during spikes depending on cluster size"
- "Cost sensitivity: wants clear levers (batching, KV caching, quantization) and preflight cost estimates per 100k messages"

Current status / internal notes:
- POC to ingest 500k artifacts (tickets + KB articles + macros) and validate recall, precision, citation correctness. Focus on citation fidelity metric (source recall) and freshness lag.
- Infosec requested SOC2 Type II report + network diagram. Sending redacted SOC2 and KMS whitepaper in Drive.
- Architecture preference: Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) in a VPC with private control plane OR on-prem box for EU-regulated customers. Will evaluate Redwood Dedicated as primary.
- Demo feedback: liked automatic prefix caching and model fallback; wants explicit SLA language for spike recovery.

POC acceptance criteria (short):
- Citation precision > 92% on sample of 500 queries
- Freshness lag < 10 minutes for new high-priority KB entries
- End-to-end p95 latency < 500ms at 200 req/s baseline and maintained with auto-burst to 1k req/s for 10 minutes
- Successful tool-calls in 95% of scripted flows (ticket update, escalate, add note)

Stated blockers: SOC2 artifacts + demo of geo-residency. Procurement timeline: exec sign-off target 2026-04.
